name: apple-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Apple Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Mail via AppleScript/JXA

scripts.bundle: npm run build:helper && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=server/index.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p server/bin && swiftc -O -framework EventKit -framework Foundation -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker eventkit/Info.plist eventkit/helper.swift -o server/bin/eventkit-helper
